status: Every prompt has a current response; partial/open responses are not closed findings

questions.question: Total SA demand development
questions.answer: Partial: reported 2024 sales are 20.763 bn L; coverage awaits reconciliation. Provincial history ends in 2022.

questions.question: Eastern SA market within economic striking distance
questions.answer: Open: location and illustrative costs show reach, not accessible customer litres. Need destinations, tariffs and rights.

questions.question: Greater diesel use in power generation
questions.answer: Partial: generation history is shown; recent OCGT use falls. Diesel-litres attribution still needs fuel-use evidence.

questions.question: Rail to road
questions.answer: Partial: road/rail payload history is shown. Payload alone does not prove modal substitution or diesel effects.

questions.question: Changes in fuel price
questions.answer: Partial: complete-year price history is staged. Travel response and real-price effects remain uncalibrated.

questions.question: More fuel-efficient vehicles
questions.answer: Open: fleet stocks and new EV/hybrid sales do not establish fleet efficiency. Need fuel mix, mileage and intensity.

questions.question: Slow GDP growth
questions.answer: Partial: GDP and sector activity evidence is available; growth-to-fuel effects require explicit assumptions.

questions.question: Refinery closures
questions.answer: Partial: published capacity falls to 358 thousand bbl/day. Capacity is distinct from output and operating availability.

questions.question: Challenges at Secunda
questions.answer: Partial: FY2024 output is 29.1 million barrels, all products. Availability and petrol/diesel yields remain open.

questions.question: Closure of Mossgas
questions.answer: Open: plant-specific shutdown dates, operating status and lost product output need explicit source confirmation.

questions.question: Growth in imports and where they enter
questions.answer: Partial: 2024 net imports are 13.078 bn L. Import-growth attribution, product-specific ports and origin remain open.

questions.question: Road to rail; private-sector rail projection
questions.answer: Open: historical payload is available; private-sector service, timing and modal-shift assumptions need evidence.

questions.question: End of loadshedding and spare power capacity
questions.answer: Partial: observed OCGT generation falls. Future dispatch, spare capacity and diesel demand remain conditional.

questions.question: EV / HEV penetration projection
questions.answer: Open: sales uptake is shown, not fleet penetration. Separate BEV, PHEV and conventional hybrids; model turnover.

questions.question: Effect of EV / HEV on litres per km
questions.answer: Open: require stock mix, mileage and fuel intensity. BEVs and hybrids have different fuel-use mechanisms.

questions.question: Higher fuel prices and km travelled
questions.answer: Open: prices are sourced; mileage response and elasticity must be specified and tested before forecasting.

questions.question: Mega refinery / SAPREF restart
questions.answer: Conditional: redevelopment capacity is a scenario, not sanctioned output. Confirm FID, ramp-up and product yields.

questions.question: Secunda gas, coal and MRG diversion to 2032
questions.answer: Open: no liquid-fuel displacement is inferred. Need dated gas allocation, plant mechanism and product-output evidence.

questions.question: Natref future?
questions.answer: Open: reported FY output is available; future ownership, availability and product yields require a dated case.

questions.question: Durban storage / NMPP / Lesedi vs road and rail
questions.answer: Open: compare the same customer and product. Need full delivered costs, capacity, tariffs and service availability.

questions.question: Transport from Matola and Walvis Bay
questions.answer: Partial: gateways, published storage and schematic routes are shown. Full costs, borders and customer access remain open.

questions.question: Market share of Vopak in Dbn and Lesedi
questions.answer: Open: published storage is an asset footprint, not served demand. Need unique deliveries, transfers and matched demand.

questions.question: Potential scope for new investment?
questions.answer: Conditional: prioritise customer flows and service first. New storage requires secured incremental flows and a usable-capacity gap.
